verdict.rationale: The product's own homepage says access can be scoped 'with roles down to the table and column', alongside SSO through your identity provider. That covers the roles, table and column parts of the story, but only as a single marketing-level mention. Nothing in the pack shows row-level policies or masking policies, which are half the story. Missing for 10: row-level access policies, column masking policies, detailed first-party docs on the role/grant model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
